meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先跟你聊清工作里什么值得记、什么该跳过,帮你设计一套记笔记规则(把笔记分成几类、再贴些标签),你同意后才真正安装成专属模式,并重启用验证启用;若你要求,还会配置 Telegram 通知。
howto.when: 当你想让 claude-mem 按自己的方式记笔记时,比如新建或修改记录模式、给笔记加分类/标签、或把特定记忆发到 Telegram,用普通话说即可,就算没提“mode”也会触发。

say.text: 我想让 claude-mem 记录我给客户做设计时的每个决定和约束。
say.note: Claude 会开始访谈并帮你创建专属模式。

say.text: 帮我建一个记录科研实验的模式,把结论和风险分开记。
say.note: 这些笔记会被定义成独立类型和标签。

say.text: 以后 claude-mem 记到某些指定内容时,请用 Telegram 提醒我。
say.note: 需要先连接你的 Telegram 机器人。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude interviews you about your work and helps you design a custom rule set for claude-mem (mutually exclusive observation types and reusable concept tags). It installs the approved mode, restarts the worker, and verifies activation; optionally sets up Telegram alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers—e.g., create or change a recording mode, add categories/tags, or send Telegram notifications for specific notes—even if you don't say 'mode'.

say_en.text: I want claude-mem to record my design decisions and constraints for each client.
say_en.note: It will start the interview to build your custom mode.

say_en.text: Create a mode for research notes that separates experiment conclusions from risks.
say_en.note: Notes get their own types and tags.

say_en.text: Send me a Telegram alert whenever claude-mem logs certain types or tags.
say_en.note: You'll need to connect your bot first.
